name: extension-narrow-contents
description: The narrow-contents extension applied to a book with a two-level contents list. Proves the extension's effect matches the canonical toolchain — Principle XV names an extension without passing comparison coverage as not done. The theme sets the two contributed keys to DIFFERENT values (left 36, right 144) so a regression that applied one side's value to both, or ignored the theme and used the defaults, fails rather than passing silently. Nested entries are present because the built-in toc.indent that this entry was expected to dissolve into governs those, and the distinction between indenting nested levels and narrowing the whole list is the reason this extension exists.
